dataset.description:
This data management plan (DMP) is dedicated to store and provide access to the results obtained during the implementation of the Latvian Council of Science project No. lzp-2024/1-0015.
The project envisages production at least 3 data sets during the implementation period according to the plan of resultative measures (two data sets within interim period and one until the final stage of the project).
dataset.title: LCS FARP

dmp.description:
This data management plan (DMP) is dedicated to store and provide access to the results obtained during the implementation of the Latvian Council of Science project "Optimization of mechanochemical and chemical synthesis of iron hexacyanoferrate for application as radionuclide sorbents in free form and immobilized on textile materials for face masks" (No. lzp-2024/1-0015).
The project envisages production at least 3 data sets during the implementation period according to the plan of resultative measures (two data sets within interim period and one until the final stage of the project).
